scientific_integrity: Claims concern the two canonical forms of the entire specified family, with a provably primitive integral Frobenius fixed lattice; Kondo–Shimada geometric input and Rams–Schuett sharp count are explicitly attributed. No external independent validation is claimed. Both arithmetic Picard lattices are further proven to be integrally generated by rational line and degree-two line-trace classes.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric invertible Frobenius coefficient matrices over the field of three elements are classified. Geometric Hermitian line counts and geometric NS basis are previously known. The arithmetic fixed lattice was verified with exact symbolic computation but no independent scholarly audit.
title: Arithmetic line and Picard-lattice dichotomy for Frobenius–Hermitian quartics over \(\mathbb F_3\)
